D/ CONSTAN TINVSAVG ; R/ SARMATIA DEVICTA

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Sarmatia Devicta issue of 323, Reece period 16, Trier mint, RIC vol. 7 no. 429. Obverse description: Bullnecked bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN TINVSAVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing right with palm and trophy, captive right. Reverse inscription: SARMATIA DEVICTA. In exergue: PTR(. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 18.6mm, Weight: 3.06gms, die axis: 12
